title: Clarity Week — deck + open-mic notes (planning)
summary: Working notes and agenda for the company-wide Clarity Week session. Includes a compact set of draft OKRs for cross-org review, a concise exec update to surface risks, and an open-mic format plan for Q&A and feedback capture.
purpose: Create a tight, actionable all-hands that surfaces 3 cross-company priorities, aligns teams on measurable outcomes for the next quarter, and collects questions/concerns in a structured way for follow up.
context: Post-Series C, small engineering lift, ramping Dedicated sales. We need to refocus around inference economics and reliability as the product differentiator. This is earlier-draft content intended for review by execs and the product-ops working group before finalizing slides.
goals_and_okrs: O1: Reduce average hosted API per-token cost while protecting quality
KR1.1: Reduce per-1000-token serving cost by 18% (mix of batching + cache + quantization recommendations) by quarter end
KR1.2: Ship two automated batching profiles in Redwood Optimize that cover >=60% of short-response traffic
KR1.3: Maintain model-accuracy regressions <1% on critical eval-suite for top-5 customer prompts
O2: Improve SLAs and predictability for Dedicated and Private customers
KR2.1: Deliver Private beta (VPC) to 2 pilot customers with onboarding checklist and runbook
KR2.2: Reduce p95 inference tail latency for Dedicated instances by 25% for sequence lengths <= 512
KR3.1: Reduce mean time to debug a failed request (trace -> fix) by 35% using Console improvements and runbook templates
KR3.2: Ship per-route cost breakout in Console (alpha) and onboard 5 internal teams as early users
exec_update_bullets: Hosted API demand: token volume up ~32% QoQ; unit economics improving slightly but not fast enough vs our target
Dedicated pipeline: 3 active procurement conversations; two require Private deployment option (VPC) before close
Product stability: incidence of degraded model-serving due to KV-cache thrash spiked twice last month; mitigations in progress (patch landed last week)
Hiring: SRE hiring on track but slow; need contingency for on-call coverage during Clarity Week
Finance: runway unchanged since Series C; small headcount hiring window available for critical infra roles
allhands_plan: Run length: 60 minutes total (target) — strict timeboxing
0–5m: Opening (CEO) — 90s framing on why Clarity Week matters — top 3 outcomes we expect
5–20m: Exec update (CPO + CTO) — 5 slides total: metrics, top risks, mitigation ask
20–35m: Product ops highlight — demo of the Console per-route cost alpha
35–50m: Breakout open-mic (structured): 3 questions seeded, ~12m for live Q&A, scribes capture follow-ups
50–60m: Wrap and asks — clear owner+ETA for all follow-ups; short pulse survey link delivered in chat
risks_and_blockers: Risk: Delayed Private beta due to network/security review timelines at pilot customers — contingency: self-hosted demo environment for sales calls
Risk: Performance regressions from experimental quantization configs — contingency: gated rollout with canary traffic and automatic rollback
Blocker: SRE bandwidth for on-call rotations during rollout week — ask: one-week cross-team swap and temporary pager escalation policy
Blocker: Missing clear owner for per-route cost UX — ask: Product manager assignment by EOD Friday
asks_and_followups: From Eng infra: ETA on KV cache fix verification in staging (owner: Ethan) — target: 2025-03-21
From Sales: list of pilot customers that require VPC by 2025-03-24 (owner: Sofia)
From People Ops: confirmation of Clarity Week logistics and recording policy (owner: Noah) — target: 2025-03-15
From Finance: quick estimate on quarterly spend headroom for 2 infra hires (owner: Janelle) — target: 2025-03-19
next_steps: Finalize 5-slide exec update deck (Maya + CTO) — draft due 2025-03-16
Run technical dry-run with SRE + serving-runtime leads 2025-03-17
Publish pulse survey and post-event follow-up template in #all-company Slack immediately after event
Create a decision log page on Confluence for any priority shifts agreed in the session
notes_to_self: Keep the all-hands tight — fewer slides, more clarity. Don't try to answer deep technical questions live; capture them and route to subject-matter breakout. Emphasize measurable next steps and owners.
document_footer: Draft — internal only. Treat this as a working agenda; pull requests to the deck go to the product-ops folder on GitHub.
